s.hlu.wo: At the Sozialamt of your city or district. A letter or phone call is enough to report your situation.
s.hlu.u1: Pension notice, notice about the reduced earning capacity or proof of other income
s.hlu.tip: Contact the Sozialamt as soon as your money is not enough. The help only starts once the office knows about your situation (§ 18 SGB XII).
fw.hlu: At the Sozialamt of the city or district; a letter or phone call is enough. The help only starts once the Sozialamt knows about the hardship (§ 18 SGB XII): report early
t.hlu.voraus: Hilfe zum Lebensunterhalt is only for people who cannot work or already receive an old-age pension and get no other Grundsicherung. Anyone who can work gets Grundsicherungsgeld from the Jobcenter.
t.hlu.gsaVorrang: From the Regelaltersgrenze or with permanent full reduction in earning capacity, you get Grundsicherung im Alter from the same Sozialamt instead. It takes priority.
t.hlu.ggBezug: You receive Grundsicherungsgeld from the Jobcenter. Then there is no Hilfe zum Lebensunterhalt (§ 5 SGB II). If you get an old-age pension, tell the Jobcenter.
t.hlu.vorgezogen: Anyone who receives an old-age pension before the Regelaltersgrenze gets no Grundsicherungsgeld and no Grundsicherung im Alter yet. If the pension is not enough, the Sozialamt pays Hilfe zum Lebensunterhalt. This does not apply to a widow's or orphan's pension if you can work.
t.hlu.emZeit: If your full reduction in earning capacity has only been established for a limited time (for example a temporary pension), you get Hilfe zum Lebensunterhalt from the same Sozialamt instead of Grundsicherung. The amount is similar to the Grundsicherung card. If it is permanent, only Grundsicherung applies.
t.hlu.kinder: Children under 15 get Hilfe zum Lebensunterhalt from the same Sozialamt. The Sozialamt includes them; the amount on the Grundsicherung card already includes the children. If a child is 15 or older and can work, the children usually belong to the Jobcenter.
t.hlu.partner: If your partner is younger than the Regelaltersgrenze and already receives an old-age pension, they get Hilfe zum Lebensunterhalt instead of Grundsicherung im Alter. Same Sozialamt, similar amount; the office calculates you together.
t.hlu.verwandte: You live with parents or other relatives. The Sozialamt then assumes that they support you as far as their income allows (§ 39 SGB XII). You can disprove this. The assumption does not apply in case of disability or need for care. Under 25 living with your parents, the Jobcenter may also be responsible. The assumption also does not apply to pregnant women or to parents with their own child under 6 who live with their parents.
t.hlu.paar: If your partner can work, they belong to the Jobcenter (Grundsicherungsgeld). Anyone receiving an old-age pension then gets help from the Sozialamt only for themselves; with a temporary reduction in earning capacity, this person usually also belongs to the Jobcenter. Have both checked.
t.hlu.kind15: If a child is 15 or older and can work, it belongs to the Jobcenter (Grundsicherungsgeld). The Jobcenter is then usually responsible for the whole household, except for a person with an old-age pension. Have this checked.
t.hlu.heim: In a residential home the Sozialamt pays the standard rate and the housing costs; it settles the housing costs with the home.
t.hlu.keinG: The additional allowance for the Merkzeichen G is only paid here from the Regelaltersgrenze or with full reduction in earning capacity (§ 30 SGB XII). It is not included.
t.hlu.unterhalt: Maintenance: the Sozialamt only claims money back from parents or adult children if they have more than {eur:100000} a year. For children under 18 this limit does not apply. The office can check maintenance from a separated spouse without this limit (§ 94 SGB XII).
t.hlu.siehe: More on the card “Hilfe zum Lebensunterhalt”.
t.rundfunk.hlu: If you are granted Hilfe zum Lebensunterhalt, you can be exempted from the Rundfunkbeitrag. Then send the notice to the Beitragsservice.
z.hluWg: Hilfe zum Lebensunterhalt and Wohngeld are not paid at the same time. Have both checked and ask which way gives you more.
t.kindergeld.lerzg: In Saxony there is Landeserziehungsgeld between a child's 1st and 3rd birthday: {a} a month for the first child, {b} for the second, {c} from the third, for 5 to 12 months. Only without a subsidised Kita or childminder place and with at most 30 hours of work a week; for the first and second child there is an income limit. Apply at the Elterngeldstelle of the district or independent city; backdated for one month only.
t.hlu.wg: You live with others in one flat, for example in a flat share. The Sozialamt may assume that you share a household and that they support you (§ 39 SGB XII). You can disprove this, for example with a statement that everyone manages their own money.
t.ggeld.vorgezogenPaar: For couples this only applies to the person with the old-age pension. The other person can get Grundsicherungsgeld from the Jobcenter. The amount is then split between the Jobcenter and the Sozialamt.
t.but.hlu: Children who receive Hilfe zum Lebensunterhalt from the Sozialamt are also entitled to the education package (§ 34 SGB XII).
